name: SelfManager.ai
description_en:
SelfManager.ai is a date-centric task and work-log service. Each day holds tables for different areas of work, with tasks, notes, comments and time records. Important tables can be pinned for access across dates; built-in AI can propose dated plans and review recorded periods.

The organizing decision matters more than the generic project-management category: this is a day-and-table workflow. Its official walkthrough excludes calendar synchronization and enterprise features such as sprints, dependency scheduling and resource allocation. Evaluate it when a dated record and review habit fit the work, while checking what gets repeated, shared and sent to AI. This profile is documentation research without a live account test.
description_zh:
SelfManager.ai 是按日期组织任务和工作记录的服务。每天包含用于不同工作领域的表格，记录任务、笔记、评论和工时；重要表格可固定，供跨日期访问，内置 AI 可提出带日期计划并回顾已记录周期。

其组织方式比泛化的项目管理分类更重要：它按日期与表格工作。官方介绍明确排除日历同步，以及冲刺、依赖排程和资源分配等企业能力。如果日期记录与回顾习惯适合工作，可以评估，并检查哪些内容会被重复、共享或发送给 AI。本文依据文档，没有实际测试账户。

core_features.explanation_en: Repeat a table on scheduled dates with explicit copied-field exclusions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按计划日期重复表格，并明确部分字段不复制。

sections.title_en: Start with one day and one reviewable outcome
sections.title_zh: 从一天和一个可回顾结果开始
sections.en:
For a hypothetical freelance day, create separate tables for a client revision and administration. Record the revision’s concrete steps, status and supporting notes rather than treating time spent as proof of completion. Pin the longer-running engagement so it remains accessible from another date.

New accounts include yesterday/today/tomorrow starter material, which can be edited or removed. Distinguish it from your own history before using a review. Choose a small real outcome for the first day, then inspect what the following day shows and how unfinished work is carried forward. This is a suggested pilot; no account or client work was created.
sections.zh:
假设自由职业者安排一天，可以为客户修改和行政工作各建一张表，记录修改的具体步骤、状态及背景笔记，不能把投入工时当作完成证明。较长期客户事项可以固定，便于从其他日期访问。

新账户有昨天／今天／明天的引导样例，可修改或移除。回顾前应区分样例与本人历史。建议第一天选择一个真实小结果，再检查次日显示什么，以及未完成工作如何延续。本次没有创建账户或客户工作。

sections.title_en: Approve a generated plan before it becomes tables
sections.title_zh: 生成计划成为表格前先审阅
sections.en:
AI Plan accepts a period up to thirty-one days and can use recent work as context. Its documented preview lets the user edit daily cards, tasks, priorities and included days before approval creates dated tables. The feature guide says generated plan tables initially have time tracking off and logs on.

AI Review instead looks back across a chosen period, including custom windows up to ninety days. For a pilot, compare a short review with known task records and inspect missing context. A sensible-sounding recap cannot validate delivery quality or explain causes that were never recorded. Check the selected context and timer settings before relying on the proposed plan or totals.
sections.zh:
AI Plan 接受最多三十一天的周期，可使用近期工作作为背景。文档预览允许修改每日卡片、任务、优先级和包含日期，批准后才生成带日期表格。功能指南说明，生成计划表格默认关闭工时跟踪、开启日志。

AI Review 则回看所选周期，自定义窗口最多九十天。试点可将短回顾与已知任务记录比较，并检查缺失背景。摘要看似合理，不能验证交付质量，也不能解释从未记录的原因。依赖计划或汇总前，应检查所选背景与计时设置。

sections.title_en: A recurring habit repeats a table, not a row
sections.title_zh: 循环习惯重复整张表，而非单行
sections.en:
The FAQ describes routines as whole repeating tables. A scheduled day receives a fresh copy when opened; repeats fill today and future dates, not historical dates. Repeating individual rows inside a non-repeating table is not supported, so a single recurring task needs its own small repeating table.

Deadlines and reminders are not copied to repeated days, while images and comments stay with their original day. For a weekly client check, inspect the next occurrence’s unchecked tasks and dates instead of assuming all reminders follow. Pausing or deleting a repeat should be evaluated separately from retaining previously created daily records. No repeat was set up here.
sections.zh:
FAQ 将日常循环定义为整张表重复：打开计划日期时生成新副本，范围是今天和未来，不补历史。在不重复表格里单独为一行设循环不受支持，因此单个循环任务需要独立小表。

截止日期和提醒不会复制到重复日期，图片及评论留在原日期。对于每周客户检查，应查看下一次出现的未勾选任务与日期，不能假设所有提醒自动跟随。暂停或删除循环与保留已生成每日记录应分别评估。本次没有配置循环。

sections.title_en: Inspect the table and attachment audience
sections.en:
The homepage describes sharing selected tables rather than the whole personal system, with collaborators working on the chosen material. It also describes task timers, comments, notes and files in the same work record. The retained context can be useful for a handoff, but the quality of a summary depends on what was actually entered.

For the revision example, keep internal personal notes outside the shared table and inspect another participant’s view. Check whether the AI request includes comments or documents and review the displayed scope before sending it. Do not equate a private daily journal with shared table comments. This profile did not upload files or verify per-role access and export fidelity.
sections.zh:
官网说明可以共享所选表格，而非整个个人系统，协作者在指定材料上工作，同一记录还可含任务计时、评论、笔记和文件。保留背景有助于交接，但摘要质量取决于实际录入内容。

对于修改样例，应把内部个人记录留在共享表之外，并检查另一参与者视图。AI 请求前应核对是否包含评论或文档，审阅显示范围再发送。私有每日自述与共享表评论不能混同。本次没有上传文件，也未验证各角色访问与导出保真度。

sections.title_en: Treat connected-assistant access as a separate configuration
sections.title_zh: 把助手连接作为单独配置评估
sections.en:
MCP is documented as a private beta. Permissions distinguish reading, changes, shared-table writes, media/doc access and deletion. The guide says Make changes is initially selected, whereas additional scopes need selection. A read-only pilot therefore needs an explicit permission check.

The assistant cannot share tables, change roles or invoke the app’s own AI Plan/Review. Deletion is documented as irreversible; a whole table counts as one object. The guide provides an activity view and specific errors for beta access, inactive plans, stale sign-in, rate limits and stale previews. Inspect the result and activity before repeating an uncertain write; these documented controls were not tested. No assistant was connected or message sent.
sections.zh:
MCP 文档标为私测，权限区分读取、修改、共享表写入、媒体／文档访问和删除。指南称 Make changes 初始勾选，其他附加范围需选择，因此只读试点也需要明确检查权限。

助手不能共享表格、修改角色，或调用应用自身 AI Plan／Review。删除被说明为不可逆，整张表算一个对象。指南提供活动视图，以及私测资格、套餐失效、登录过期、限流和预览过期等具体错误。重复不确定写入前，应检查结果和活动；本次未测试这些控制，也没有连接助手或发送消息。

sections.title_en: Separate a flat subscription from AI usage
sections.title_zh: 区分固定订阅与 AI 用量
sections.en:
Monthly prices are Individual USD 8 and Team USD 30 flat, with annual totals USD 72 and USD 300. The pricing page calls both annual discounts 25%; USD 300 versus USD 360 is about 16.7%, which the FAQ correctly rounds to 17%. Use the totals and confirm checkout. The seven-day no-card trial is not ongoing free use.

Included AI allowances are 35/70 credits weekly; extra credits start at 50 for USD 2.50. Fast starts at 1 credit and Thinking at 5, increasing with context and response size. For specified Thinking models, an interrupted request may incur the displayed maximum even before output appears. Review the estimate and interruption policy. Optional storage is another cost, so a flat team fee does not imply unlimited AI or document capacity.
sections.zh:
月付为 Individual 8 美元和 Team 固定 30 美元，年付总额分别为 72 和 300 美元。定价页称两者年付都优惠 25%，但 300 相比 360 约节省 16.7%，FAQ 正确约为 17%。应采用总额并核对结账。七天无需银行卡的试用不等于持续免费。

每周包含 35／70 积分，额外积分最低 50 个售 2.50 美元。Fast 从 1 积分、Thinking 从 5 积分开始，随背景和输出量增加。指定 Thinking 模型的请求中断后，即使未输出也可能按显示最高值计费，应审阅估算和中断规则。可选存储是另一项费用，固定团队费不代表 AI 或文档容量无限。

sections.title_en: Check exit conditions and choose the workflow deliberately
sections.title_zh: 核对退出条件，主动选择工作方式
sections.en:
The terms describe SaaS access under a plan, rather than a grant of platform IP. Subscriptions renew until canceled; cancellation preserves access until the paid period ends, and refunds are not offered. Data is retained until deletion is requested, subject to the stated conditions, and exports are available on request. These statements are not an export or recovery test.

Shortlist it when dated tables and retrospective notes fit daily work. If the requirement is automatic calendar scheduling or dependency/resource planning, the official walkthrough identifies those as outside its scope. Before adoption, check one day’s continuity, a representative shared table, the AI meter and a usable export. No uptime, speed, personal productivity or psychological benefit was measured.
sections.zh:
条款规定按套餐使用 SaaS，而不授予平台知识产权。订阅自动续费至取消，取消后可访问至已付周期结束，不提供退款。数据按所列条件保留至请求删除，导出可按请求提供；这些说明不是导出或恢复测试。

如果按日期表格和回顾记录适合日常工作，可以列入候选。如果需要自动日历排程或依赖／资源规划，官方介绍已说明不在范围内。采用前应检查一天工作的延续、代表性共享表、AI 用量和可用导出。本次未测量在线率、速度、个人生产力或心理收益。

seo.title_en: SelfManager.ai: Dated Tables, AI Planning, Routines and Usage Costs
seo.title_zh: SelfManager.ai：日期表格、AI 规划、循环与用量成本
seo.description_en: Evaluate date-based planning, repeat exclusions, editable AI plans, private-beta MCP permissions and subscription costs.
seo.description_zh: 评估按日期规划、循环排除项、可编辑 AI 计划、私测 MCP 权限与订阅费用。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate a dated planning and review workflow.
secondary_questions: What gets copied by a repeating table?
Does a flat team plan include unlimited AI?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent hypotheses; no measured search volume or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No sign-in, shared table, routine, AI generation, timer, MCP connection, deletion or export test. Current quota enforcement, provider behavior and recovery require validation.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试登录、共享表、循环、AI 生成、计时、MCP 连接、删除或导出。当前额度执行、提供方行为与恢复需验证。

research_gaps.en: Exact checkout taxes, plan-change proration, complete export format, beta eligibility, model availability, full processing/residency conditions, interface languages and regions remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体结账税费、套餐变更按比例处理、完整导出格式、私测资格、模型可用性、完整处理／驻留条件、界面语言与地区仍未核实。
